messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU queue depth rising in dedicated-prod-usw2. queue_delta=+5200 reqs, avg_wait=13.8s
maria.gomez: seeing 5xx spikes and 429 throttles across /v1/generate, /v1/embed. dashboards: https://dash.redwood/boards/queue_usw2
pagerduty: Trigger: GPU_EXHAUSTION_USW2 (P1) — Assigned to janet_oncall
ryan.cho: @janet_oncall can you check autoscaler activity and node driver logs?
janet_oncall: autoscaler attempted adds but failed: maxReplicas enforced by cluster-policy. Also nodes showing repeated `Xid` and OOMs. pasting kernel snippet:
```
Mar 16 01:02:12 node-87 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1b.0): 79, GPU fell off bus
Mar 16 01:02:12 node-87 kernel: nvidia: gpu_reset: reset ok
Mar 16 01:02:15 node-87 dockerd: container exited with code 137
```
luis_infra: autoscaler log:
```
I0316 01:03:20 autoscaler.go: ScaleUp requested=8 current=32 max=32 -> Error: reached maxReplicas
```
maria.gomez: effective capacity dropped while autoscaler capped — queue growth +5000 in 20m. we need immediate relief: route bulk jobs to hosted fallback and reduce model concurrency.
janet_oncall: starting traffic steering: sending /api/v1/embeddings and heavy batch routes to hosted-fallback canary 30%
devops-bot: routing-config updated: /api/v1/embeddings -> hosted-fallback (canary=30%) :white_check_mark:
olga_support: customers "Orbis" and "Maply" reporting errors. posting incident banner and initial customer message now.
ryan.cho: attempt to stabilize nodes without full reboots: cordon noisy nodes and restart nvidia modules.
janet_oncall: executing:
```
kubectl cordon node-87
kubectl drain node-87 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
ssh root@node-87 'systemctl restart nvidia-driver || (rmmod nvidia && modprobe nvidia)'
```
janet_oncall: driver restart succeeded on node-87, Xid errors reduced. re-opened scheduling to test.
luis_infra: after remediation queue decreased by ~1300, but still high. autoscaler still at hard cap. quota increase request to cloud initiated (may take 40min).
maria.gomez: rolling change to lower per-pod concurrency from 12->5 to reduce memory pressure. starting canary roll.
devops-bot: rollout started: model-server v3.2 -> CONCURRENCY=5 (progress 6/80 pods)
janet_oncall: also cleared in-memory KV caches on canary nodes to reduce working set.
```
POST /internal/clear_kv_cache
Authorization: Bearer ****
```
janet_oncall: cache flush confirmed on canaries.
ryan.cho: monitoring: p50 chat latency from 14s->6.2s after routing+concurrency. queue trending down but intermittent node flaps remain.
maria.gomez: logs suggest driver version 532.16.03 may have memory regression. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
devops-bot: notify: @eng-runtime @eng-ml — suspected driver regression causing GPU OOM/Xid under high concurrency workloads.
alex.klein: I'll lead driver investigation. need repro load and exact kernel/driver versions. created ENG-1901 for rollback testing and ENG-1902 for runbook.
janet_oncall: handoff to eve_night in 20m. summary: routing done, concurrency reduced, 2 nodes cordoned+remediated, cache flush, customers notified. queue draining but autoscaler cap blocks quick recovery.
janet_oncall: Handoff details:
- start_ts: 1737554321
- mitigations: traffic steering to hosted, reduced concurrency, cordoned nodes (87, 92), cache flush on canary
- current: queue decreasing, nodes stable for 12m, autoscaler at maxReplicas
- followups: request quota bump, validate driver rollback (532.16.03 -> 532.06.x), create cordon+driver-restart runbook

eve_night: acknowledged. taking over pager. will monitor and update every 30m. :night_with_stars:
maria.gomez: postmortem owners: eng-runtime (alex.klein), infra (luis_infra), product (maria.gomez). initial RCA: driver memory regression + autoscaler hard cap + high concurrency. impact: ~15% requests in us-west-2 saw >10s latency or errors during peak. support ticket INC-1737554321 created.
olga_support: customers notified; Maply requested SLA ticket. Support assigned INC-1737554321 to account team.
alex.klein: starting bisect on driver and kernel combos. ENG-1901 created for rollback/validation, ENG-1902 for runbook + incident playbook.
ryan.cho: final status: mitigations holding; incident moved to monitoring. schedule postmortem tomorrow 10:30 PT. tagging follow-ups for 72h.
incident-bot: Incident 1737554321 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager set to watch for 24h for reoccurrence.
